whatIs.title: What is ToursRed?
whatIs.description:
ToursRed is a Mexican platform that connects travelers with local agencies to discover and book authentic experiences throughout Mexico.

ToursRed does not directly operate tours.
Published experiences are created and operated by allied agencies, while ToursRed facilitates the search, booking and contact process in a simple and secure way.

Our goal is to promote local tourism, providing agencies with a digital showcase to grow and travelers with a reliable way to discover new experiences.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.content:
COOKIE POLICY

TOURS RED GLOBAL S.A.S. DE C.V.

Last updated: February 2026

1. What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet or mobile) when you visit websites. Cookies allow the website to remember your actions and preferences (such as language, font size and other display preferences) for a period of time, so you don't have to reconfigure them every time you return to the site or browse from one page to another.

2. What types of cookies do we use?

2.1 Essential Cookies

These cookies are strictly necessary for the basic functioning of the website. They include session cookies, language preferences and security. These cookies cannot be disabled.

  • Consent cookie: Stores your cookie consent preference
  • Language cookie: Remembers your language preference (Spanish/English)

2.2 Analytics Cookies (Google Analytics)

We use Google Analytics to analyze website usage and improve our services. These cookies collect information anonymously about how visitors use our site.

Google Analytics Cookies:

  • _ga: Unique identifier to distinguish users. Duration: 2 years.
  • _gid: Unique identifier to distinguish users. Duration: 24 hours.
  • _gat: Used to throttle request rate. Duration: 1 minute.

These cookies help us to:

  • Understand which pages are most visited
  • Know the time spent on the site
  • Identify browsing patterns
  • Improve user experience
  • Optimize site performance

Important: Google Analytics does NOT collect personally identifiable information. Data is collected in an aggregated and anonymous manner.

3. How do we manage your consent?

When you visit our site for the first time, an informative banner will appear requesting your consent for the use of analytics cookies.

You can:

  • Accept cookies: Google Analytics analytics cookies will be activated.
  • Reject cookies: Only essential cookies for site operation will be used.

Your decision will be saved for 12 months. After that period, you will be asked for your consent again.

4. Third-party cookies

We use Google Analytics, a service provided by Google LLC. Google may use the collected data to contextualize and personalize ads on its own advertising network.

For more information on how Google uses data, see:

  • Google Privacy Policy
  • How Google uses data when you use our partners' sites or apps

5. How to disable or delete cookies?

5.1 Through our site

You can revoke your consent at any time by clicking on the "Cookie Preferences" link located in the footer of our site.

5.2 Through your browser

You can configure your browser to reject all cookies or to notify you when a cookie is sent. However, if you disable cookies, some parts of the site may not work properly.

Instructions by browser:

  • Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data
  • Firefox: Options → Privacy and security → Cookies and site data
  • Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Cookies and website data
  • Microsoft Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions → Cookies and site data

5.3 Disable Google Analytics

Google offers a browser opt-out add-on:

https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

6. Updates to this policy

ToursRed reserves the right to modify this Cookie Policy at any time. The updated version will be published on this page with the date of last update.

We recommend that you review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we use cookies.

7. Contact

If you have questions about our Cookie Policy, you can contact us at:

  • Email: contacto@toursred.com
  • Website: https://www.toursred.com

8. Applicable legislation

This Cookie Policy is governed by the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP) and other applicable regulations in the United Mexican States.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?

hero.title: Travel eSIM
hero.subtitle: Connect as soon as you land without swapping SIM cards. International data plans with exclusive discounts for ToursRed travelers.

intro.title: What is an eSIM?
intro.description: An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a digital SIM card that activates directly on your smartphone without needing to swap a physical chip. Buy your data plan before departure and activate it in seconds upon arrival.

benefit1.title: No SIM swapping
benefit1.description: Activate your data plan in seconds directly from your phone settings.

benefit2.title: Global coverage
benefit2.description: Plans available for over 200 countries and destinations around the world.

benefit3.title: Exclusive discounts
benefit3.description: As a ToursRed traveler, you get special discount codes with our partner providers.

benefit4.title: Instant activation
benefit4.description: Buy online, receive by email, and activate when you arrive. No lines, no waiting.

partners.title: Our eSIM Partners
partners.subtitle: Click on each card to reveal your exclusive discount code
partners.legal: By clicking each partner's button you will be redirected to their external website. ToursRed acts as a referral intermediary. Conditions, prices and plan availability are the responsibility of each provider.

step1.title: Choose your plan
step1.description: Select the partner, destination and data plan that best suits your trip.

step2.title: Apply your discount
step2.description: Use your exclusive ToursRed code at checkout to get your discount.

step3.title: Receive by email
step3.description: You will receive activation instructions and your eSIM QR code by email.

step4.title: Activate on arrival
step4.description: Scan the QR from your phone settings and you're connected instantly.

compatible.title: Is my phone compatible?
compatible.description: Most modern smartphones are eSIM compatible. Before purchasing, verify that your device supports eSIM and is unlocked. Compatible models include iPhone XS or later, Samsung Galaxy S20 or later, Google Pixel 3 or later, and many more.
